scope: assets and standalone lab; game/recruitment/stages untouched

species.name: 火狐
species.design: small sacred white fox, vermilion ear tips and ONE bushy tail with red tip, amber eyes, tiny gold knotted collar with ONE red tassel
species.anchors: head (.64,.40), tail (.28,.43), four paws on baseline .82
species.action: tail coils toward back; tail extends upward; tail flicks forward to launch foxfire

species.name: 癒蝶
species.design: ONE sacred butterfly, symmetrical two pairs of ivory and jade-green wings with gold veins and vermilion teardrop markings, slender charcoal body, exactly TWO antennae
species.action: wings close above back; wings open wide; wings cup forward to release healing pollen

species.name: 岩亀
species.design: ONE sacred stone tortoise, grey-violet carved hexagonal shell, ivory face and four short feet, golden shimenawa rope around shell and two white zigzag paper streamers
species.anchors: head (.68,.60), shell center (.46,.50), four feet on .82
species.action: head withdraws; shell crest lights gold; head extends and front foot stamps

species.name: 雷烏
species.design: ONE sacred raven with navy-violet feathers, ivory wing edge feathers, golden beak and eyes, vermilion knot around neck, exactly TWO wings and ONE tail
species.action: wings lift above shoulders; wings sweep forward for dive; wing tips spread to emit lightning

species.name: 疾狼
species.design: ONE adult WOLF guardian with long canine muzzle, tall straight legs, narrow flowing tail and lean powerful shoulders, ivory/cyan fur, gold forehead crest and vermilion collar; NOT a fox or puppy; FOUR legs, fierce amber eyes, cyan wind ribbons around sides; the torso is a ghost contour with a large EMPTY transparent interior for a host
species.action: head lowers and forelegs coil; head and forelegs reach forward; tail and wind ribbons recoil into ready pose

species.name: 白鹿
species.design: ONE actual adult white DEER, long elegant neck, narrow elongated herbivore face, horizontal deer ears, FOUR long thin legs ending in split dark hooves, tiny SHORT deer tail, gentle amber eyes, TWO branching pale-jade antlers with exactly THREE branch tips per antler, gold neck rope with red tassel; never fox face, pointed fox ears, paws or bushy tail
species.anchors: head (.65,.38), antler crown (.62,.17), four hooves on .82
species.action: head and antlers lower; antlers lift high; front hoof stamps as antler flowers open

species.name: 鈴梟
species.design: ONE round sacred owl, golden-brown and ivory feathers, two golden eyes, ONE tiny gold bell tied with vermilion cord on chest, exactly TWO wings
species.action: wings open; bell swings left and gold chest mark lights; wings close and bell swings toward center

species.name: 剣鬼
species.design: ONE large sacred oni warrior spirit, ivory/red oni mask with exactly TWO short gold horns, charcoal-red lamellar torso armor, TWO spectral arms, ONE long ivory katana held by right hand, lower body tapering into red-white ribbons; translucent central torso with clear opening for a host
species.action: katana tip raised at (.25,.22); katana sweeps to (.80,.45); katana follows to (.78,.70) while torso remains behind host

species.name: 守熊
species.design: ONE full-body translucent ivory/amber sacred bear guardian, broad shoulders, TWO round ears, gold forehead knot, vermilion neck rope, TWO large forearms and paws, transparent central belly opening for host; gold shield crest on palms
species.action: arms open wide; arms overlap in front with palms facing outward; arms settle into embracing guard

species.name: 火車
species.design: ONE ivory/vermillion sacred cat with TWO ears, ONE curling tail, amber eyes, riding a single golden flaming wheel; cat remains upright while wheel turns; tiny red neck tassel
species.anchors: cat head (.62,.36), wheel center (.48,.61), wheel bottom on .82
species.action: cat crouches over wheel; cat extends front claws and wheel flames lean left; cat reaches forward as flame rim bursts

species.name: 泉鯉
species.design: ONE ivory and pale-blue sacred koi carp with TWO gold whiskers, red forehead spot, blue dorsal fin and ONE flowing forked tail, gold scale accents
species.anchors: head (.70,.48), tail (.24,.48), curved body across center
species.action: tail bends left/up; body straightens and head lifts; tail bends right/down and water beads fall

species.name: 命蛇
species.design: ONE translucent ivory/jade sacred serpent with ONE head, TWO gold whiskers and no legs or wings, gold forehead jewel and vermilion neck ribbon; exactly THREE open spiral coils forming a tall enclosure, empty transparent central channel for host
species.action: head rises; three coils gently contract without crossing order; coils open and head returns halfway

species.name: 金獅子
species.design: ONE ivory/gold sacred lion, thick golden shimenawa-like mane with vermilion knot, amber eyes, TWO round ears, FOUR paws, ONE tail, white muzzle and gold claws
species.action: head recoils and mouth opens; head thrusts forward to bite; mouth closes and mane recoils

species.name: 祈鶴
species.design: ONE white sacred crane, red crown, long charcoal beak, gold neck ring with red ribbon, TWO white wings with charcoal tips, exactly TWO slender legs tucked in flight
species.action: wings lift; wings fan forward to form guard; wings ease into glide

species.name: 神狐・九尾
species.design: ONE majestic ivory/gold sacred fox with exactly NINE distinct bushy tails in a fan behind body, vermilion ear tips, amber eyes, golden forehead crest and red-gold neck knot; count NINE tails consistently, no extra foxes
species.action: nine tails fold closer while all nine remain visible; all nine tails fan wide in fixed order; tail tips brighten in three groups of three for foxfire release
